exploit workers: Some factories exploit workers by making them work twelve hours a day for very low pay.
有些工廠剝削勞工，讓他們一天工作十二小時卻只拿很低的薪水。
exploit an opportunity: When the rival store closed, the smart owner quickly moved to exploit an opportunity to win new customers.
當競爭對手的店關門時，精明的老闆迅速利用機會爭取新顧客。
exploit natural resources: The government plans to exploit natural resources such as oil and gas found under the sea.
政府計畫開發天然資源，例如在海底發現的石油和天然氣。
exploit a weakness: A good chess player will always try to exploit a weakness in the opponent's defense.
優秀的棋手總是會設法利用對手防守上的弱點。
explore options: Before choosing a university, you should explore options carefully and talk with your teachers and parents.
在選擇大學之前，你應該仔細探索各種選項，並和老師及父母談談。
explore the issue: In this report, the students explore the issue of plastic waste and suggest ways to reduce it.
在這份報告中，學生們探討塑膠垃圾的議題，並提出減少它的方法。
explore a career: Summer internships give teenagers a chance to explore a career in medicine before they apply to college.
暑期實習讓青少年在申請大學前有機會探索醫療方面的職涯。
explore the city: We rented bicycles on our first morning in Kyoto so we could explore the city at our own pace.
我們在京都的第一個早上租了腳踏車，好按照自己的步調探索城市。
expose a scandal: A young reporter spent a year gathering evidence to expose a scandal involving several powerful officials.
一位年輕記者花了一年蒐集證據，揭發一樁牽涉數名有權勢官員的醜聞。
be exposed to risk: Without proper safety training, workers on building sites may be exposed to risk every single day.
如果沒有適當的安全訓練，工地的工人可能每天都暴露於風險之中。
expose children to music: Many parents believe it is important to expose children to music from a very early age.
許多父母相信，從很小的時候就讓孩子接觸音樂是很重要的。
expose the truth: The documentary helped expose the truth about how the company had polluted the river for years.
這部紀錄片幫助揭露了該公司多年來如何汙染河川的真相。
expose a lie: The security camera footage was enough to expose a lie the suspect had told the police.
監視器畫面足以揭穿嫌犯對警方說的謊言。
extend a deadline: Because so many students were sick, the teacher agreed to extend a deadline by one more week for the science project.
因為很多學生生病，老師同意把科學專題的期限再延長一週。
extend an invitation: To show that the argument was over, Tom smiled and decided to extend an invitation to his old friend for dinner.
為了表示爭吵已經結束，湯姆笑著決定向老朋友發出邀請，請他來吃晚餐。
extend one's thanks: At the end of the ceremony, the principal wanted to extend his thanks to all the volunteers.
典禮結束時，校長想向所有志工致謝。
extend credit: The bank refused to extend credit to the small company because its sales had dropped sharply.
由於這家小公司的銷售額大幅下滑，銀行拒絕提供信貸給它。
extend a helping hand: After the earthquake, people from all over the island came to extend a helping hand to the victims.
地震過後，全島各地的人都前來向災民伸出援手。
extend one's lead: Our team scored twice in the second half to extend our lead to four points.
我們的隊伍在下半場又得了兩分，把領先擴大到四分。
face the music: You broke the window, so now you have to face the music and tell your father what happened.
窗戶是你打破的，所以現在你得承擔後果，告訴你爸爸發生了什麼事。
face reality: He kept dreaming about becoming a pop star, but eventually he had to face reality and find a job.
他一直夢想成為流行歌星，但最後他不得不面對現實去找份工作。
face a challenge: Every new student will face a challenge when moving to a school in a different country.
每個新生轉到不同國家的學校時都會面臨挑戰。
face charges: The driver who caused the accident will face charges of drunk driving next month.
肇事的司機下個月將因酒駕遭起訴。
face the facts: We need to face the facts: our club does not have enough money to hold the event this year.
我們必須正視事實：我們的社團今年沒有足夠的錢舉辦這個活動。
face up to: Instead of blaming others, you should face up to your own mistakes and learn from them.
與其責怪別人，你應該勇敢面對自己的錯誤並從中學習。
facilitate learning: Teachers use games and group discussions in class to facilitate learning and keep students interested.
老師在課堂上運用遊戲和小組討論來促進學習，並維持學生的興趣。
facilitate communication: The new messaging app was designed to facilitate communication between parents and teachers.
這個新的通訊應用程式是為了促進家長和老師之間的溝通而設計的。
facilitate a meeting: Our class leader was chosen to facilitate a meeting where everyone could share ideas for the school fair.
我們的班長被選出來主持一場會議，讓大家都能分享校慶園遊會的點子。
facilitate trade: The two countries signed an agreement to lower taxes and facilitate trade across the border.
兩國簽署了協定，降低稅率並促進跨境貿易。
